text:
marta: quick one : on the roles table, should SSO state be a dedicated column, an inline badge, or only in the org header? I worry new admins miss it if it's buried.
devin: inline badge for discovery. column feels heavy and wide.
liu: Badge ok, but for screen readers we need it exposed in the row reading order. Also color alone won't do.
jamal: If we do badge, make two sizes: full text 'SSO required' on desktop, icon-only on small widths. click/tap opens role details.
compliance-bot: Reminder: any UI that filters by SSO state must be included in CSV exports per policy 3.2.
marta: Good call @compliance-bot. Also: microcopy swap suggestion: 'Require SSO for this role' vs 'SSO required' which reads better inline?
devin: Inline wants brevity -> 'SSO required'. In the role drawer we can use the full phrase.
liu: Accessibility notes I'll add: badge should have role="status"? maybe aria-live=polite when changed, and aria-label="SSO required for role: Admins (enabled on 2025-03-10 by jamal)". Ensure tooltip is keyboard accessible.
jamal: Audit access: instead of sending people to Settings, let's add a tiny link in the Roles header 'View role activity' that opens a right-side panel filtered to role events. Panel title: 'Activity for access control' vs 'Role activity'  thoughts?
devin: 'Role activity' is succinct. Panel needs quick filters: event type, actor, date range, and an export button.
marta: Panel mustn't trap keyboard focus. It should be dismissible with ESC and restore focus. Also when opened from an invite flow, pre-populate event type=invite.
compliance-bot: Audit requirements: default columns must include actor_email, action, timestamp, ip (masked if not allowed), and resource_id. Export must include raw IP only for users with network_admin role.
liu: Mobile UX nit: if we add badge per row, test with long role names and user counts. Might need ellipsis and a detail drawer for the full info.
jamal: I can prototype both badge sizes and a compact row variant that moves metadata into a second line.
marta: Next steps: @jamal mock two variants (inline badge full + compact icon-only) in Fig; @liu drop specific ARIA attributes and a11y test plan; @devin wire the panel interactions and keyboard map; @compliance-bot (or @anita) confirm export masking copy. 20m review tomorrow?
devin: I'll sketch keyboard map and attach a tiny key cheatsheet to the panel (e.g., 'g' then 'r' opens roles, 'g' then 'a' opens audits).
liu: I'll add screen reader sample snippets so QA can verify.
jamal: will post Figma links by EOD and a quick prototype for mobile.
marta: awesome, thanks :thumbsup: well reconvene after review.
